scientific_integrity: An exact nonmembership argument supplies a missing sharpness assertion; a standalone finite computation supplements but does not replace the proof or referenced infinite upper-bound theorem. Novelty is relative to inspected published sources and is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Theorem fixes only the sixth golden-ratio power and exactly eighteen positive-index summands. It uses the published global upper-coverage theorem. Other powers, least additive order, and all gaps are not classified.
title: Sharp conductor of the eighteen-fold sixth-power golden-ratio Beatty sumset
